title: Empty Wardrobe
subtitle: Why left these clothes at the dining table and the floor? Someone should clean them up quickly.

items.text: Empty Wardrobe
Sotheby searches all over the place, and stops before the crucible.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Wow ...! How could there be such a big crucible! Amazing!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The potion here is ... beer? No.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The formula is very similar to my hallucinogen! But it's alcoholic!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh my gosh. How did he make it! What is the most crucial material?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: She dips her finger in the potion and puts it in her mouth. Soon she writes something down on the paper hastily.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Eh ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ah ...! That's it. I got it? I got it!!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I finally got the right answer!!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Who is that alive and kicking young lady over there?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She is the heir to an auction house in London, England, and helped us a lot this time.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh! ☆

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hi! Ms. Sotheby!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We're taking notes of everyone's wishes. I'd say, would you like to come and have a look?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hah? Take notes of wishes?! I have many wishes! I am coming!!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come here. Just register with Vertin!

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: My wish?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... If this was the last moment in your life ... what wish would you want to make?

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: My lord, are we gonna die?

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: We are starving for too long, my lord ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: I want to have dinner with my family. For us Italians, that's the best moment of life.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mine?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I have no wish ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What is your wish? May I realize it for you?

items.speaker: X
items.text: A few refugees have already passed out from hunger. Needless to say, you know what they need, right?

items.speaker: X
items.text: For me, a cup of espresso would be great.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I already knew the right formula for the hallucinogen! I want to realize everyone's wishes!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I will prepare a delicious meal!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Hmm, wishes ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: *sighs* ... Failure to prepare a decent meal for Miss Sotheby is a stain on my butler career ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I think ... there is a way to address your problems, Mr. Karson.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Enjoy the dinner Ms. Sotheby prepares for everyone tonight.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Huh!!!
Depths, Scorched Woods

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The sun goes down.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The water on the ground has reached the ankle.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Out of the tent, a diminutive figure kneels on the ground. She seems to be murmuring.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I didn't know you prayed.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're the last one to tell me your wish.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Although you won't go, I still want to know.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Do you want to hear my wish, my lord?

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Then my wish is ... don't forget me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Well ...
Ok. I got it.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Then my wish is ... don't forget me.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: It's raining again.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: The buildings outside the suitcase start to melt, but no one mentions it.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Sotheby's Chew-Chew Hallucinogen XII works. The refugees finally get to have real food.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: "Desire," as she said, is the symbol of the most important ingredient.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ahh ...! I'm exhausted! How tiring it is to cook!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Finally we delivered the meals to all the refugees, but our soup became cold. Aww!

items.speaker: X
items.text: Oh? Thanks to your hallucinogen, what I see happens to be a parfait ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: *chewing* It also tastes the same ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I had the souffle. Miss Sotheby, thank you for the meal.

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: Fi-filet steak! Sorry I gotta have some more ...

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: Ptooey!!!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What happened? What's wrong?

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: Whoa ... what is that tast ...

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: It tastes like corned beef, dust and baseball gloves someone just wearing it ... oh ...

items.speaker: Everyone
items.text: *laughters*

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Sir, you have to believe what you see!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: If you don't believe it from the bottom of your heart, even the hallucinogen won't help!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Don't be fooled by the "Storm". What I prepared for you is definitely the best food in the world!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: *cough*

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson! What happened to you? Is there anything that doesn't suit your appetite?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: No, it tastes amazing, my lady.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What did you eat, Mr. Karson?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: A burnt Welsh rabbit.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Ah! That's ... that's my ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The first cheese you made when you were eight. And you burnt the tulips in the Chelsea Flower Show.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: That's a relief to me, my lady.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Please take this.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What's this thick book ...?

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: The records of all the important transactions and dealings of our manor, some secret lists, and the location of the treasury.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: These are Master and Madam's favourite wine and weekly schedules.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Okay. But ... the second half seems to be all about ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: All of your favourite menus.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: You want different dishes every day, and new preferences every time ...

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Hah, one is barely enough.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: My lady, please take good care of yourself.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Try to get in touch with Master and Miss Moissan after everything ends.

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: You will be a fair lady, Ms. Sotheby.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I will do my best! ... But why didn't you hand it to father in person?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Enormous sound of rain comes from outside the suitcase.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Whoa ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What a heavy rain outside ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The rain turned upside down! Oh my ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Come and see! Mr. Karson, quick!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Hmm?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson ... where are you?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The "Storm" is here.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Thanks for your treat ...

items.speaker: Man In Black
items.text: I-I can have one ... more ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Holy Mary pray for us … Holy Mary pray for us …

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Look after us ... Have compassion on us ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't be afraid, sis. Take my hand. Close your eyes ... Just like when we were born ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Everything will be fine ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Goodbye.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: *cough* ... My lord ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Schneider ... I'm sorry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Your family ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: No, my lord.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: She stands on her feet, runs towards Vertin and falls into her embrace gently. Now, once again, she looks like a pale pigeon.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Hold me.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: I am sorry. I'm not a real arcanist.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What do you mean? I-I don't understand ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: I always wanted to be lucky, but ... I think I should say goodbye now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Goodbye?! You mean the "Storm" will also ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No!!! Why? ... You've never eaten the gold bar in front of us!!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are you always tolerating it?!

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Heh heh ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Now it's coming, my lord ...

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't forget me.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Don't forget my heartbeat on the right.
THE END
